title: Map IMAP read-only command selection and mailbox health
limitations: Read-only git archive; no Git metadata; remote not verified from this container.
No mailbox, account, or provider calls.
Repository IMAP tests NOT_RUN: /repo has no node_modules and installs are forbidden.
No native/account/model/human qualification or release acceptance claim.
CAPABILITY is sent and its result discarded; LOGINDISABLED is not honored (static).
Live-account IMAP qualification remains unrun, as CURRENT.md already states.

findings.invariant: Honest auth: LOGIN should not proceed if the server advertised LOGINDISABLED (RFC 3501 §6.2.3).
findings.note: open() awaits client.send("CAPABILITY") and ignores the untagged CAPABILITY list, then sends LOGIN unless the greeting was PREAUTH.

findings.invariant: Health detail should distinguish missing mailbox from a selectable mailbox that omitted UIDVALIDITY/UIDNEXT.
findings.note: Any protocol or misconfigured error from examine() becomes misconfigured / folder not found: <display>.

findings.symbol: IMAP CLOSE never sent; LOGOUT is ordinary close
findings.invariant: Mailbox close must not expunge. Production uses LOGOUT (implicit close without expunge) or TCP close. IMAP CLOSE is not a production verb.
findings.note: After EXAMINE, RFC CLOSE would not expunge, but the connector still never sends it. ImapClient.read treats the LOGOUT-required untagged BYE as unreachable; logout() swallows that.

findings.invariant: Spec said examine returns exists; current MailboxStatus is { uidvalidity, uidnext } only.
findings.note: Spec drift. P006 owns canonical docs; this packet does not rewrite them.

findings.invariant: NOPERM and other unmapped codes are protocol, not a dedicated health state.
findings.note: On EXAMINE they collapse into folder not found via F2.

existing_coverage.decision: Did not duplicate those tests. Added an out-of-tree transcript checker for ordinary select/read/close plus CLOSE rejection.

downstream_handoff.use: Line-referenced inventory and JSON map are the command/response contract. Transcript checker plus fixtures are the integration artifact for read-only verbs. Existing in-tree tests remain the product tests; do not copy them. Rebase and review before production use. P006 owns canonical docs (EXISTS spec drift is F4). Live IMAP qualification is separate.
downstream_handoff.ordinary_close: LOGOUT or TCP close, never IMAP CLOSE
downstream_handoff.health_path: open + EXAMINE each folder + LOGOUT; pending walk notes degrade the next health() once
